_readme: Hand-curated knowledge that the source data does not contain.
Edit this file by hand; build.py picks it up on the next run. No code changes needed.
Run `python curate.py` to see which events still need attention, ranked by impact.
artists        {name: [genres]}  Genres are ADDED to whatever the text matcher found.
and also matches the artist name appearing in the title.
not_electronic [names]           Artists who are simply not in this scene. An event whose
only signal is one of these is dropped from the dataset.
events         {url: {genres}}   Final say for one specific event, keyed by its ticket URL
(copy it from the app). REPLACES all detected genres.
Use [] to drop a single event.
Valid genre labels are listed in normalise.KNOWN_GENRES; build.py warns on typos.
This seed is deliberately small - only entries that are clearly correct. Extend it.
